lines.text: A mighty angel wrapped in a cloud comes down from heaven holding a small scroll that lies open.
He places his right foot on the mountain and his left foot on the land, and he cries out like a lion.
A voice from heaven tells John to seal up what the seven thunders have said and not write it down.
The angel swears there will be no more delay, and the mystery of God will be fulfilled when the seventh angel sounds, as God told the kings.
John eats the small scroll, which is sweet as honey in his mouth, but his stomach turns bitter.
